svg.title: Focus Areas
svg.desc: Full Stack; automation and integrations; applied security.

g.text: REST APIs, web dashboards and databases in Node.js projects,
from the back end to the interface users see.
Bots and services connecting Discord, Mercado Pago (Pix) and
OAuth2 login, role-based access, payment confirmation straight
from the provider's API, and protection against spam and raids.
